direction.observed_defect: Ground surface lacks architectural integration, appears flat and untextured, fails to convey fantasy-medieval prairie depth or terrain variation, no stone slope transitions or microdetail from donor grass texture.
direction.design_intent: Create a luminous, textured meadow with soft golden dry-grass transitions and pale exposed slope stone, using donor grass as microdetail, preserving all terrain geometry and boundary, avoiding new geometry or painting paths.
direction.reason_for_new_geometry: No new geometry required; existing terrain mesh is editable; design is texture-based, not topology-based.

planned_actions.rationale: Apply baked material with macro meadow variations, soft dry_fraction blend, donor tiled at detail_tile_m, detail_strength modulated color/normal, rock color only above slope threshold.

direction.expected_visual_difference: Luminous, textured meadow with soft golden dry-grass transitions and pale exposed slope stone, microdetail from donor grass texture, no flat green field or gritty photoreal floor.
direction.mobile_risks: Low; baked material retains A/B camera, lights and geometry, no new geometry or painting paths, glTF-compatible color and tangent normal atlases (1024 square).
